content.title: How to watch Timberwolves at Magic tonight: game preview, injury updates and TV and streaming info | Minnesota Timberwolves
content.text: The Minnesota Timberwolves are back in action Wednesday for a road matchup against the Magic in Orlando.Wednesday marks the second night of a back-to-back for Minnesota, following a dominant 124–104 win over the Indiana Pacers on Tuesday. Ayo Dosunmu set the tone with 24 points and five rebounds, while Julius Randle added 19 points. The Wolves also got a major boost from the bench, with Bones Hyland finishing with 19 points and seven assists and Naz Reid chipping in 17 points.Sixth in the West at 47–32, the Wolves have gone 5–5 over their last 10 games and hold a 22–17 record on the road. Minnesota currently ranks fifth in the league in defense (111.9 defensive rating) and 12th in offense (115.2 offensive rating).Here’s your full guide to Wednesday’s Timberwolves at Magic matchup, including the latest injury report and how to watch live.How to watch, stream & listen to Timberwolves vs. MagicDate: Wednesday, April 8Start Time: 6 PM CTTV Channel/Live Stream: FanDuel Sports NetworkRadio: iHeartRadio | Timberwolves app | KFAN 100.3Where: Kia Center | Orlando, FLWolves at Magic tips off at 6 PM on Wednesday, April 8 from the Kia Center in Orlando. The game will be broadcast and streamed on FanDuel Sports Network.Injury ReportNote: Tonight's injury report will be updated before the start of the game.Timberwolves Out: Rudy Gobert, Mike Conley, Ayo Dosunmu, Anthony Edwards & Julius RandleRudy Gobert (Rest), Mike Conley (Rest), Ayo Dosunmu (Right Calf; Injury Maintenance), Anthony Edwards (Right Knee; Injury Maintenance) and Julius Randle (Right Hand; Soreness) are out.MagicQuestionable: Jamal Cain & Wendell Carter Jr. Out: Jett Howard & Jonathan IsaacJamal Cain (Left Calf; Contusion) & Wendell Carter Jr. (Nasal; Fracture) are questionable to play. Jett Howard (Left Ankle; Sprain) and Jonathan Isaac (Left Knee; Sprain) are out.Jerseys Timberwolves: Classic EditionMagic: Association EditionThe Wolves will be in their black trees Classic Edition uniforms against the Magic, who will be in their white Association Edition uniforms.What to know about the MagicNinth in the East at 43-36, Orlando enters Wednesday's matchup on a three-game win streak. The Magic are 5-5 in their last 10 games and are 24-15 at home.The Magic are ranked 14th on defense (113.9 defensive rating) and are 18th on offense (114.1 offensive rating). Wednesday marks the second and final meeting between Indiana and Orlando this season. The Magic lead the season series 1-0.Led by Paolo Banchero, Orlando's rotation will include Tristan da Silva, Wendell Carter Jr., Desmond Bane, Jalen Suggs, Anthony Black, Jevon Carter, Goga Bitadze, Moritz Wagner and Jamal Cain.
